NDT software in Austin: fabs, data centers and a construction boom

NDT software for an Austin inspection company has to support fast-moving construction and high-purity industrial work where the paperwork is as scrutinised as the welds. The Atlantis ERP solution keeps technicians, certificates, calibrated instruments, dispatch, NDT reports, quoting and invoicing in one system configured for the work Central Texas actually generates.

Austin's inspection market is younger than Houston's and shaped by very different clients. Samsung's semiconductor fab in Austin and its large new fab in Taylor, Tesla's Gigafactory Texas on the east side, and a growing list of data centers, battery and advanced manufacturing projects bring process piping, high-purity gas and chemical lines, structural steel and large mechanical systems. The I-35 Capital Express reconstruction and continued high-rise building downtown and along the river keep structural and bridge inspection busy. Austin Energy and the Lower Colorado River Authority operate generation, transmission and the Highland Lakes dams, and there is ongoing pipeline and utility work across Travis, Williamson, Hays and Bastrop counties.

The contractor profile is distinctive. Some Austin NDT firms are local and small, often founded by a Level III or a CWI who saw the construction boom coming. Many others are Houston or San Antonio contractors running satellite crews into Austin projects for months at a time. Either way, the general contractors and owners here expect clean digital records, quick turnaround and proof that every technician and instrument was qualified on the day. Radiography licences come from the Texas Department of State Health Services, and pipeline work answers to PHMSA and the Railroad Commission of Texas.

ERP for NDT companies in Austin: the short answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Austin should give you digital, auditable records that a fab owner's quality team or a large general contractor will accept, without adding office staff. The Atlantis NDT ERP does that by connecting certificates, instruments, procedures, crew assignments, NDT reports and billing to each job.

On a large industrial construction project, the owner's QA/QC group will ask for the certificate of every technician on site, the calibration certificate for every instrument used, the approved procedure revision and the report, often weeks after the work. When those live in separate folders and email threads, a small NDT company spends days reassembling them. In the Atlantis ERP they are already linked. The report references work order, WPS, drawing, procedure and standard; the technician's certificate status is computed automatically; and the instrument's calibration status was checked when it was assigned.

For firms running satellite crews from Houston or San Antonio, the ERP is cloud-hosted and accessible, so the Austin site lead and the head office work from the same data. See all of the apps on the ERP apps overview.

NDT reporting software for fab, data center and structural work

The NDT reports app covers 17 report types, including VT, RT, UT, PAUT, TOFD, MT, PT, UT thickness, hardness, PMI, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures.

Austin industrial work leans heavily on certain methods. Stainless and high-purity process lines bring visual inspection, radiography, PMI to confirm alloy, and ferrite measurement on welds. Structural steel for fabs, data centers and towers brings UT and MT on connections. Large-bore utility and process piping brings RT or PAUT. The report app captures method-specific data for each: UT probe calibration table, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, PAUT focal laws, MT technique and particle type, and weld lines with defect type and orientation. The overall result is recorded as acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports reference work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard, which is how a fab project's turnover package is organised. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, with Excel templates filled by mapping fields to cells, let you match the owner's required format. Inside large buildings under construction, signal is often poor, so the offline field app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later. Third-party or authorized inspector names and signatures can be captured. For owners who want inspection results on a 3D model, see Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Technician certification tracking software for Austin project crews

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates for every certificate and computes status automatically as active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked. Warning tasks appear 90 days before expiry, and configurable email alerts go to the people you choose.

Austin project owners commonly require proof of qualification before a technician is badged onto site, and they ask again at turnover. The certificate record stores industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and attachments, and supports SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes, which matters when a project brings in technicians qualified elsewhere or when an international equipment vendor's inspectors are on site. Vision tests with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry are tracked separately.

The employee NDT profile records highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Company certifications, such as your quality accreditation, carry their own alert days. Timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid, which catches problems during a busy project month when everyone is looking at the schedule, not the cert list. See the certificates app.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Central Texas projects

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs jobs as team assignments from planned to dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers is blocked.

Austin project work comes in waves. A fab tie-in window opens, a data center piping package needs RT over a weekend, and a bridge contractor on I-35 wants MT on the same days. The availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable, and blocks overlaps. Each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date, which is what you need when deciding whether to bring more people up from Houston or San Antonio. Time Off approvals feed the same calendar.

If a coordinator assigns an instrument that is out of calibration, the ERP warns at the moment of assignment. Calendar, kanban and list views give the project lead and the office their own view of the same schedule. Mobilisation dates also feed expenses and per diems for crews living in Austin during a long project. More on team assignments.

Calibration management software for high-scrutiny sites

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument and probe by serial number, with calibration frequency, status and next due date, and holds a calibration certificate register with lab accreditation number, validity status, PDF and expiry alerts. Out-of-calibration equipment triggers a warning when assigned to a job.

On fab and data center projects, the owner's QA team will ask for calibration certificates for PMI analysers, ferrite meters, UT flaw detectors, thickness gauges and densitometers used on specific welds. Each calibration record captures provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag and pass, fail or conditional result. The lifecycle status shows which items are in calibration, in repair or rented out.

The issue and return workflow records condition at checkout and return with supervisor and manager approval, reservations prevent clashes, and inbound and outbound movements are logged, which helps when kit is shuttling between an Austin site trailer and a Houston or San Antonio base. The maintenance log records firmware updates and probe replacements with condition before and after. Consumables such as penetrant, developer, couplant and PPE carry reorder levels. See asset management.

Procedures and project quality documentation

The procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and text or file. Workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states, and approved revisions are locked.

Large Austin projects often require procedures to be submitted to the owner or EPC for review before work starts. The ERP keeps a snapshot of each revision, records prepared, reviewed and approved by with dates, and captures rejection reasons, so a comment from the owner's reviewer produces a clean new revision rather than a confusing file named final-v3. Email notifications and reminders keep your Level III on top of pending approvals.

The AI-assisted first draft helps start a new project-specific procedure, with a built-in template as fallback, and your Level III reviews and approves it. Procedure and WPS references carry through to project tasks, which record method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts. See procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Austin contractors

Quoting and invoicing in the Atlantis ERP use the same job data, so estimates, timesheets and invoices agree. Quotes carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, can be accepted and signed online, and convert to sales orders.

Construction clients in Austin tend to require detailed backup with every invoice. Invoice headers carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables. Lines show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval, and they feed billing. Standby while waiting for a tie-in window or for fit-up to finish is recorded and billed rather than absorbed.

Expenses and per diems for crews working away from home can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices and a 12-month view. See quotations and invoicing.

Inspection management software: CRM, dashboards and integrations

Inspection management software in Austin needs to help you win project work and watch risk across it. KPI dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue, next to the financial dashboard.

The CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, with a 0 to 100 NDT lead score. That is useful for tracking bids with mechanical contractors, EPCs and general contractors on fab, data center and infrastructure projects. Leads can be imported by CSV, and AI-personalised email previews and drip sequences help follow-up. The Business Cards app turns cards from pre-bid meetings into leads. Surveys can gather client feedback after a project closes.

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation, which helps when an owner or EPC wants data in their own system.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Austin

The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request based on the apps and configuration you need. Atlantis NDT, founded by an ASNT NDT Level III, carries out implementation, so written practice, calibration and report format decisions are made by people who know them.

For a local Austin firm, rollout usually starts with certificates, instruments and NDT reports, since those are what project owners audit. For a Houston or San Antonio contractor with an Austin satellite, we set up the Austin site as its own location for dispatch and reporting while sharing technicians and equipment with head office. Report templates are matched to owner turnover requirements, Texas taxes and invoice layouts are configured, and integrations are scoped. The offline field app is installed on crew devices. If you train technicians, the eLearning app and the Practical NDT 3D simulator are available; Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A based NDT training. Book an Austin ERP demo.

Frequently asked questions

What NDT software works best for Austin fab and data center projects?

Software that links every report to the technician's certificate, the instrument's calibration and the procedure revision. The Atlantis ERP does this and supports VT, RT, UT, PAUT, PMI and ferrite reports used on these projects.

Can a Houston contractor run an Austin satellite from the same system?

Yes. Technicians and equipment are shared across locations, and team assignments show who is committed in Austin and who is free elsewhere.

Is it suitable for small NDT companies in Austin?

Yes. It is affordable and fully customizable, and you can start with the apps project owners care about most. Pricing is quote on request.

Does it work inside buildings with poor signal?

Yes. The offline field app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs when connection returns.

Can it send data to an owner's or EPC's system?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How quickly can we get started?

After a first session on your methods, clients and report formats, we give you an implementation plan. Request a plan.
